takes.title: Mime Boxing with Close Steps and Turns
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands gathered, then alternates short steps and arm extensions while turning through several headings. The take ends with both hands raised and one foot crossing behind.

takes.title: Mime Boxing with Wide Weight Shifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps the hands near the upper chest, alternately steps wide and draws the feet in, and makes short arm motions between shifts. They finish in a narrower bent-knee stance.

takes.title: Mime Boxing with Deep Side Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts hands-up, shifts into deeper bent-knee steps, and repeatedly turns into profile. They finish in a wide side-facing stance with one hand held forward.

takes.title: Mime Taking a Drink and Recapping the Bottle
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands together, lifts one hand to the mouth and tilts the head, then returns both hands to the chest. The CMU source identifies the final motion as screwing on a bottle cap.

takes.title: Mime Opening a Bottle and Taking a Drink
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands in front, lifts one hand toward the mouth as the head tilts, and returns to a hands-together stance. The CMU source describes opening a bottle.

takes.sourceDescription: jumping jacks, jog, squats, side twists, stretches
takes.title: Do Jumping Jacks, Jogging Steps, and Side Stretches
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, moves through quick steps and repeated arm raises, then changes to side bends and twisting reaches. They return to standing with both arms lowered.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up to grab, reach for, tiptoe
takes.title: Reach Overhead from a Bent-Knee Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright and repeatedly bends the knees, springs upward, and reaches high with one or both hands. The final pose stays side-facing with one arm overhead.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up to grab, reach for, tiptoe
takes.title: Spring Upward into Overhead Reaches
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer repeats two-handed overhead stretches and small jumps with both feet briefly off the floor. They end upright with the arms lowered.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up to grab, reach for, tiptoe
takes.title: Alternate High Reaches and Small Jumps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, alternates one-handed and two-handed high reaches, and briefly leaves the floor during several attempts. The take ends upright with arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime Window Washing with a High and Low Pass
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a hand near the forehead, sweeps it outward, bends forward for a lower reach, and returns to high arcs. The last pose keeps one arm extended to the side.

takes.title: Mime Mopping with Short Low Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright resets with forward bends and low strokes, shifting the feet and changing direction between passes. They finish with head lowered over the hands.

takes.title: Act Out Laughing with a Forward Fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms relaxed, bends sharply forward, then straightens and gestures with one hand. The take ends standing and angled to the side.

takes.title: Step Up and Turn into the Descent
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins standing, raises alternate knees to step up, turns near the top, and steps down again. They finish upright in profile.
